question: Among executed entries whose PumpPortal and Helius counterfactuals traverse the same guard-override path, can every mismatch be attributed to a recorded preset, eligibility, wallet-context, market-input, or state-age/source difference?

findings: The Helius counterfactual already used its aligned tape-derived market vector, but guard-family telemetry omitted that vector and falsely displayed null market inputs.
A null curve-progress diagnostic was coerced to LT_25 by Number(null); null is now UNKNOWN.
Executed entries that selected different guard-override paths were counted as provider mismatches even though they were not same-path comparisons.
Observed and comparable executed-entry denominators used the same field name.
corrections: Populate guard-family market diagnostics from the actual PumpPortal state and Helius shadow state used by each decision.
Represent missing curve progress as UNKNOWN.
Keep full gate counterfactuals visible, but exclude cross-guard-path executed entries from the mismatch-attribution denominator with COUNTERFACTUAL_GUARD_PATH_MISMATCH.
Report observed and comparable executed entries separately.

postRunInstrumentationAmendment.reason: The counterfactual recomputed a score internally, but V9 telemetry omitted the exact shadow score and sniper-capture inputs. Three same-path entry skips were labeled LOW_SCORE while the emitted market vector showed score=null, so the mismatch attribution artifact could not prove which input the gate used.
corrections: Expose the exact recomputed shadow score, sniperWalletCount, and sniperWalletCountCaptured values used by the counterfactual.
Mark a shadow gate evaluation INCOMPARABLE_SCORE_INPUT when the recomputed score is absent instead of emitting LOW_SCORE.
Require complete exact market-input telemetry on every comparable gate evaluation.

postRunInstrumentationAmendmentV2.reason: The run exposed three data-integrity defects: a shutdown close was counted as an active provider failure, the exact-market-input count only tested shadow field presence and accepted false capture flags, and the Helius counterfactual scored a synthetic zero sniper count while declaring it uncaptured.
corrections: Classify Helius shutdown errors and disconnects only from explicit listener-emitted STOPPING phase fields within a bounded shutdown window; retain separate shutdown counters and do not infer phase from event ordering.
Rename exact-market-input telemetry to complete source-attributed market-input telemetry and require complete actual and shadow score, curve, flow, buyer, and sniper fields.
Reconstruct sniperWalletCount from Helius first-reference early buys using the frozen launch-intel sniper window; emit INCOMPARABLE_WALLET_FEATURES when reconstruction is incomplete.
Expose current curve and sniper-count sources; encode actual-lane observation history as one held-constant baseline control, never as independently sourced actual-versus-shadow evidence.

postRunInstrumentationAmendmentV3.reason: The first post-V2 runtime validation showed that PreMigrationWatchLane stored sniper provenance internally but its toSummary boundary omitted sniperWalletCountSource and sniperWindowAnchoredAtFirstObservation. All 5590 otherwise-comparable evaluations therefore emitted captured sniper counts with null provenance and correctly invalidated the run.
corrections: Carry sniperWalletCountSource and sniperWindowAnchoredAtFirstObservation through PreMigrationWatchLane.toSummary so actual and Helius shadow decision states preserve the producer provenance.
Emit the same provenance on pre_migration observed telemetry for direct runtime inspection.
Add a merge-to-summary regression fixture instead of relying only on producer and telemetry source-text assertions.
State explicitly that the anchor boolean proves only reference existence; true-to-true does not prove that provider windows share an anchor instant.
Emit each provider's exact sniper-window anchor timestamp, anchor kind, and configured window length; report signed and absolute anchor skew as provenance-only diagnostics.
Require exact anchor provenance for complete comparable market-input telemetry without treating anchor skew as a causal gate-input mismatch.
Align the session-started market-input semantics label with the amended completeness rule before the next eligible run.

postRunInfrastructureAmendmentV4.reason: The same invalid instrumentation run also exposed burst-shaped event-loop pressure. PumpPortal delivered 66589 trade callbacks across 34506 setImmediate-delimited turns, including five turns with at least 50 callbacks and a maximum of 131. PumpPortal trade synchronous-prefix work averaged 11.12273 ms, while runtime lag reached 1277 ms. This is attribution evidence, not causal proof.
corrections: Replace immediate and duplicate completion-triggered PumpPortal queue drains with one latched setImmediate scheduler.
Start at most the configured event-handler concurrency per drain turn without changing the configured concurrency.
Cancel a pending queue drain during shutdown and preserve explicit stop-discard accounting.
Report drain schedules, calls, items, yields, max batch, queue latency, and provider callback burst histograms.
nextRunChecks: PumpPortal eventQueueDrainMaxBatch must not exceed eventHandlerConcurrency.
PumpPortal queue drops, stop discards, and handler errors must remain zero for a clean comparison.
PumpPortal provider max callbacks per setImmediate-delimited turn should be bounded by eventHandlerConcurrency; failure is a scheduler instrumentation defect.
Queue latency and state freshness must remain visible and acceptable; reducing callback bursts by hiding backlog is not a pass.
Event-loop lag changes are descriptive across unequal market loads and cannot alone prove causality.

gateDecisionComparator.name: same_instant_account_enriched_window_aligned_helius_state_with_actual_lane_context
gateDecisionComparator.positionSemantics: An active position does not suppress a PAPER_SHADOWED gate pass; gate agreement measures WOULD_ENTER versus WOULD_SKIP.
gateDecisionComparator.marketFeatureSemantics: PumpPortal decisions retain PumpPortal tape-derived features and Helius counterfactuals retain Helius tape-derived features. Diagnostic guard-family payloads must expose the exact market vector each side used.
gateDecisionComparator.gatePathTreatment: Cross-guard-path gate results remain visible as full counterfactual outcomes and are never fed into strategy.

decisionComparabilityDiagnostics.purpose: Adjudicate PRESET_NOT_ELIGIBLE_FOR_GUARD_OVERRIDE mismatches and stale-state coverage without changing classification or denominator.
decisionComparabilityDiagnostics.presetPolicy: Hold the actual selected preset constant in the shadow evaluation; any evaluated-preset disagreement is instrumentation failure, not provider divergence.
decisionComparabilityDiagnostics.allowListPolicy: Record both allow-list snapshots and a tri-state eligibility value. Do not encode no selected override family as eligible.
decisionComparabilityDiagnostics.familyInputPolicy: Record curve-regime, first-curve-snapshot, crowding, and family-selection inputs on both sides so family divergence is attributable.
decisionComparabilityDiagnostics.baselinePolicy: Hold actual-lane observation history constant for both decisions and report it as one explicit control; never represent it as independently sourced actual-versus-shadow evidence.
decisionComparabilityDiagnostics.staleStatePolicy: Every non-comparable row records the best available state age and source; the report emits an age histogram without relaxing freshness.
decisionComparabilityDiagnostics.confusionMatrixPolicy: Report the ENTER/SKIP 2x2 matrix and entry precision/recall separately from overall agreement.

executedActionComparator.name: gate_coupled_same_guard_path_entry_and_same_instant_exit_with_actual_lane_context
executedActionComparator.entrySemantics: An actual entry is paired to its exact PAPER_ELIGIBLE evaluation. Entry mismatch attribution is comparable only when both sides selected the same guard-override family, including both selecting no family.
executedActionComparator.crossPathTreatment: COUNTERFACTUAL_GUARD_PATH_MISMATCH is non-comparable scope, not an attributed provider mismatch.
executedActionComparator.exitSemantics: Exit comparison retains the actual pre-observation position context and same-instant Helius state.
executedActionComparator.pnlAttributionRule: Actual paper PnL may be grouped only by comparable same-path shadow entries from a valid run and remains NOT_EVIDENCE_FOR_EXECUTION.

entryMismatchAttribution.passRule: At least one comparable same-path executed ENTRY and one same-path mismatch must be observed. Every mismatch must have one deterministic allowed cause. Zero mismatches and cross-path-only samples are insufficient evidence.
entryMismatchAttribution.positionStatePolicy: Use actual pre-observation position context as a held-constant control.
entryMismatchAttribution.guardPathPolicy: Different selected guard-override families are scope-incomparable and excluded before attribution.

paidTapePlan.billingRule: PumpPortal charges 0.01 SOL for each completed 10000-event block; a 5000-event remainder adds no projected completed-block charge.
paidTapePlan.budgetHeadroomRule: The latest excluded run used 92011 events in 54.98 paid minutes (1673.536 per minute). A 105000 cap covers the projected 60-minute demand of about 100400 events with about 4.5 percent headroom.

freezePolicy.note: The amended V9 comparator must accumulate at least three future valid runs. Ordinary disagreement, low comparability, or disappointing results cannot trigger another version.

nextIfPass: Keep Helius report-only and repeat on another valid full-coverage run before proposing provider routing.
nextIfFail: Fix only the specific same-path comparator instrumentation defect. Do not change strategy, freshness bounds, gates, exits, or provider routing.
